correctness.rationale: Exact projection Π=I−BᵀB/n gives each signed-edge squared norm (n−2)/n. Polar vertices of ker(B)∩[−1,1]^E have forest unsaturated support, which forces integral trinary entries by a cut argument. Zero-edge degree parity gives full support in odd order and maximum support precisely at perfect matchings in even order, both realizable by Eulerian orientations; star zeros exhibit strict noncontact facets in even order. An explicit alternating-S3 triangle-flow argument proves irreducibility of S_n on the cycle space; uniqueness of extremal ellipsoids forces centered balls. Exact finite checker succeeds for orders 4,5,6, and independent halfspace reconstruction agrees for orders 4,5. All-order correctness depends on the proof, not these finite checks.

value.rationale: This canonical real cographic family links a naturally specified Euclidean projection metric to regular-matroid polytope geometry and supplies exact John/Löwner bodies and a nontrivial odd–even contact transition. The John containment ratio achieves the extremal √d in every odd order and is strictly smaller in every even order, with perfect matchings furnishing the structural equality mechanism. This is an all-dimensional geometric classification not reducible to a previously published small numerical table or routine name substitution.
